verdict: Lead volume dropped this week; budget compression is the clear cause.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 130 leads at a cost per lead of $19.85, all delivered through Meta — Google Ads spent $1,239.78 across the period and produced zero attributable leads. This past week, a 35% pullback in spend drove a 50% drop in leads, with cost per lead rising 29% as a result; the data points to budget compression rather than the audience running out of steam. On Google, daily spend collapsed from as high as $87 to under $5 on some days, and we are working to stabilize delivery and establish conversion tracking before scaling resumes. New paid landing pages and a fresh creative batch are on track for August 31, which should strengthen Meta's efficiency heading into September. We are also completing pipeline automation work by August 31, which will improve how leads are handled once they come in.
